QUOTE: `_loader.py` finds `librentropic.so` in this order: `$ENTROPIC_LIB`, then `$ENTROPIC_HOME` (nested, then flat layout), then `~/.entropic`, then `ctypes.util.find_library`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives the order (env overrides, `~/.entropic`, `find_library`) but mentions the two layouts (nested, then flat) only for `$ENTROPIC_HOME`. It doesn't say both layouts are tried per root, so the item's "two layouts per root" is only partly stated.
